papers.title_en: Constrained Koopman Control Parametrization: Convex Controller Synthesis for Tracking under Input Constraints
papers.authors: Taha Ondogan, Ran Jing, Andrew P. Sabelhaus, Roberto Tron
papers.evidence: 基于 Koopman 表示并结合凸优化与输入约束的控制器综合
papers.tldr: Koopman理论可将非线性系统升维为线性/双线性形式，但输入约束下的控制器综合仍受限。本文提出cKoCoP框架，以观测线性反馈实现非线性状态反馈，并用S-procedure或Farkas引理将椭球/多面体输入约束纳入凸优化。针对跟踪引入含约束的CLF，在双摆与独轮车上验证。结果表明其满足输入约束、抗测量噪声，且在线算力明显低于KMPC。
papers.abstract_en: Koopman operator theory represents nonlinear systems with linear and bilinear terms in the state and input observables, greatly simplifying control design. However, incorporating input constraints into Koopman-based controller synthesis remains challenging, limiting their applicability to constrained control tasks such as tracking. This paper develops a constrained Koopman Control Parametrization (cKoCoP) framework for synthesizing state-feedback controllers that satisfy prescribed input constraints with Lyapunov-certified stability of the identified lifted closed loop. The cKoCoP offers nonlinear state-feedback via linear-in-observables feedback, enabling linear controller design. The proposed controller is obtained through convex optimization: we incorporate ellipsoidal or polytopic input constraints with the S-procedure or Farkas-lemma-based conditions. We also introduce a Control Lyapunov Function (CLF) for trajectory tracking which incorporates input constraints. The approach is validated on two canonical nonlinear systems, a double pendulum and a unicycle, demonstrating data-driven tracking while respecting input constraints. Experiments validate the method's robustness to measurement noise, and runtime improvements over Koopman Model Predictive Control (KMPC) baselines. The results demonstrate that cKoCoP achieves competitive tracking performance with substantially reduced online computational cost, supporting its potential for real-time constrained tracking applications.

papers.title_en: DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
papers.authors: Shafeef Omar, Sebastian Sanokowski, Elham Daneshmand, Dian Yu, Daniel Cremers, Cordelia Schmid, Majid Khadiv
papers.evidence: 结合扩散规划器与强化学习跟踪器的人形移动操作
papers.tldr: DPO 去除强任务条件依赖，并用 DA:PPO 对齐冻结跟踪器执行能力。在取-搬-放任务中成功率由 45% 提升至 99%，还能泛化到未见目标，并在 Unitree G1 实机零微调重复成功，展示规划与执行对齐的部署潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation is particularly challenging because it requires coordinating locomotion, balance, and object interaction, making it difficult to learn from limited demonstrations or from scratch through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce DiPLO (self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation), a framework that combines a self-distilled diffusion planner with a low-level whole-body tracking policy. Our planner is pretrained via supervised learning on motions derived from human-to-humanoid retargeting, while the tracker is trained via RL to execute them. DiPLO centers around two complementary post-training stages. First, we introduce Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation (SD:DPO) to remove the planner's dependence on strong task conditioning, which we identify as a crucial ingredient for effective pretraining, as downstream fine-tuning does not recover comparable performance when it is omitted.. We then fine-tune this distilled model with Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (DA:PPO), a maximum-entropy RL method for diffusion models, to improve task success and align generated plans with the frozen tracker's execution capabilities. Together, these stages enable motion generation through state-history and goal conditioning alone, enabling 99% task success in pick-carry-place tasks, compared to just 45% for the pretrained model. The resulting planner also generates motions for unseen object goals, with further evaluations on kicking and pushing/pulling tasks. Finally, we deploy our pipeline on the hardware, using our DA:PPO planner-tracker on a Unitree G1, achieving repeated successful executions without any real-world fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: Fast Motion Retargeting Pipeline for Scalable Humanoid Robot Learning
papers.authors: Daniel Marew, Sangjun Park, Nisal Perera, Donghyun Kim
papers.evidence: 人形机器人动作重定向与并行分块处理
papers.tldr: 大规模人体动作数据为人形机器人学习提供演示，但跨机器人重定向仍耗时且需逐动作调参。FRDV先用约束运动学重定向，结合自定义SQP、Real-Time Iteration与分块并行，再以接触隐式iLQR做动力学验证和修正。其运动学阶段最高9156帧/秒，较GMR与ProtoMotions约快136倍，并能减少穿地、自碰撞等伪影。该流程提升可扩展性，并通过Unitree G1展示仿真到现实迁移。
papers.abstract_en: While large-scale human motion capture datasets provide a rich source of demonstrations for humanoid robot learning, retargeting the diverse motions to different humanoid robots remains a nontrivial challenge. Existing kinodynamic trajectory optimization pipelines are computationally expensive and often require manual adjustments per motion. We present FRDV (Fast Retargeting with Dynamics Validation), a scalable framework consisting of rapid constrained kinematic retargeting and an additional dynamics validation pipeline. Its kinematic stage integrates a custom Sequential Quadratic Programming solver, Real-Time Iteration, and parallel chunk-based processing, achieving up to 9,156 frames per second, approximately up to 136 times faster than GMR and ProtoMotions, while robot-specific constraints are incorporated into the optimization to reduce common retargeting artifacts, such as ground penetration and self-collision. For motions requiring additional verification, a contact implicit iLQR controller is utilized to test the retargeted reference under full rigid body dynamics. This dynamics-based validation identifies dynamically infeasible motions and refines contact-related artifacts such as foot floating and foot skating. We evaluate retargeting quality by training motion tracking reinforcement learning policies using several state-of-the-art pipelines and comparing their tracking fidelity and success rates. Furthermore, sim-to-real transfer is demonstrated on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Videos and code are available at: https://daroslab.github.io/frdv/.

papers.title_en: One Policy, Many Styles: Where to Aggregate Preferences for Steerable Humanoid Control?
papers.authors: Ziqian Huang, Yuzhuo Chen, Shimin Zhang, Junyang He, Xinyue Annie Yang, Animesh Garg
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人可操控控制的偏好条件强化学习
papers.tldr: 可转向人形控制要求单一策略在运行时按用户偏好调整行为风格，但仅靠偏好条件化难以同时保证响应强度、行为隔离性与任务性能。论文在两类人形控制框架上，用偏好奖励响应性、覆盖率和效用指标，比较奖励层、优势层、损失层与PCGrad式偏好聚合。实验表明没有聚合层级全面最优：早期聚合行为响应更广但跨目标串扰更大，后期聚合控制更精准但响应性有所下降。该工作为偏好聚合位置的选择提供了可量化的实验依据。
papers.abstract_en: Modern robotic agents are increasingly expected to support steerable control, where a single policy can adjust its behavioral style at runtime under changing user preferences. Preference-conditioned reinforcement learning provides this interface, but conditioning alone does not ensure that a requested behavior change is strong, does not leak into unrelated behaviors, and does not compromise task performance. Our evaluation combines Preference Reward Responsiveness (PRR) with coverage and utility metrics. We use these measures to compare reward-level, advantage-level, loss-level, and PCGrad-based aggregation across two humanoid-control frameworks. No aggregation level performs best across all environments and criteria. Experiments show that aggregating objectives early produces a wider range of behavioral responses but greater unintended changes in other objectives, while aggregating them later improves control precision at some cost to responsiveness.

papers.title_en: SAFTER: Safety-Aware Filtering Through Explicit Recoverability for Robust Reinforcement Learning under Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Benedictus C. G. Cinun, Bin Hu
papers.evidence: 嵌入SAC的可微控制障碍函数过滤器保障硬安全
papers.tldr: 在有界驱动下，策略泛化到未见环境很困难，一次不安全决策可能导致不可恢复，而传统 CBF 过滤器只保证瞬时安全。SAFTER 将可微的闭式 backup-CBF 过滤器嵌入 SAC 训练，把当前安全、有限时域后备安全、终端可恢复性与输入可容许性统一为单一可微证书。四足导航中训练成功率 90%，样本效率显著提升，未见环境中成功率最高提升 42.4 与 61.4 个百分点。该工作表明可恢复性感知过滤兼具运行时安全与学习机制双重作用。
papers.abstract_en: Learning safe policies that generalize to unseen environments is difficult under bounded actuation, where an unsafe decision may become unrecoverable. Conventional control barrier function (CBF) filters enforce only instantaneous safety and ignore future recoverability. We propose SAFTER (Safety-Aware Filtering Through Explicit Recoverability), which embeds a differentiable, closed-form backup-CBF filter into Soft Actor-Critic training. SAFTER unifies current safety, finite-horizon backup safety, terminal recoverability, and input admissibility into a single differentiable certificate. Its CBF condition yields an exact minimum-intervention projection without iterative online optimization. In quadruped navigation, SAFTER reaches 90% training success with 30.6% fewer transitions than Vanilla SAC and 34.1-35.1% fewer than current-state CBF-filtered SAC baselines. Across unseen simulated environments, SAFTER improves success by up to 42.4 and 61.4 percentage points over the state-of-the-art methods CBF-RL and SEA-Nav, respectively, and achieves 73.3% and 76.7% success on two real-world navigation maps. Ablations identify accurate differentiation through the safety filter as a key contributor to robustness, in which replacing the projection Jacobian with the identity approximation reduces success rate in a High-Shift environment from 61.4% to 6.2%. These results show that recoverability-aware filtering serves as both a runtime safety mechanism and a learning mechanism for sample-efficient, robust policies.

papers.title_en: SMR: Learning streaming motion retargeting for humanoids from human semantic
papers.authors: Chun Gu, Juntong Zhang, Jingyu Li, Li Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人运动控制的流式运动重定向
papers.tldr: 将人体动作重定向到人形机器人需兼顾语义与动力学约束，但运动学流程仅做几何匹配，已有物理监督神经方法依赖双向全序列和非因果上下文。SMR把人体动作转成机器人感知的任务空间目标，由语义条件物理专家在仿真中跟踪并生成可行轨迹，再训练严格因果Transformer实现流式重定向。实验表明专家轨迹语义保真和物理有效性优于直接优化重定向，流式模型在统一全身控制器下闭环性能优于运动学与物理精炼基线。
papers.abstract_en: Retargeting human motion to humanoids requires preserving motion semantics while accounting for the robot's physical constraints. Kinematic pipelines prescribe a robot trajectory through geometric matching, without establishing whether it can be executed under the robot's dynamics. Prior physics-supervised neural methods train bidirectional full-sequence models on physics-refined kinematic trajectories, remaining tied to prescribed kinematic solutions and requiring noncausal context. We propose SMR, a streaming neural motion retargeter learned from semantic-conditioned physics experts. We convert human motion into robot-aware task-space targets for body landmark positions, orientations, and velocities. Physics experts track these targets directly in simulation under contact, dynamics, and actuator constraints. We train a single strictly causal Transformer on their executed state trajectories that complete the motion and pass semantic and physical validity checks. At each incoming frame, the student uses only current and past human observations to generate a robot motion reference for a downstream whole-body controller. Experiments demonstrate that semantic-conditioned physics experts generate motion with higher semantic fidelity and physical validity than direct optimization-based retargeting, while the resulting streaming retargeter achieves improved closed-loop performance over kinematic and physics-refined baselines under a common whole-body controller.

papers.title_en: Geometric knowledge spaces, Attention pairing and Architectures
papers.authors: Shang Xu
papers.evidence: 注意力机制与Transformer架构的几何化推导
papers.tldr: 注意力机制已被广泛使用，但缺乏统一的几何解释，Transformer 架构设计也常依赖经验试错。论文形式化“知识世界”与“注意力配对”概念，从几何视角推导注意力机制，并展示该框架可自然导出标准注意力、因果注意力、线性注意力、张量注意力及循环神经网络。作者进一步提出若干新的几何空间，用于启发潜在的新型 Transformer 架构。该工作为理解现有注意力变体与探索新架构提供了统一的理论工具。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a geometric approach to deriving attention mechanisms and exploring potential new transformer architectures. We begin by formalizing the notions of knowledge worlds and attention pairings, then demonstrate how this framework naturally leads to the architectures of standard attention, causal attention, linear attention, tensor attention, and recurrent neural networks. Finally, we introduce several new geometric spaces that may inspire novel neural network architectures.

papers.title_en: Watch Your Step: Anticipated Perception for Humanoid Locomotion
papers.authors: Matthias Heyrman, Chenhao Li, Ioannis Dadiotis, Marco Hutter
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人运动的感知型运动策略
papers.tldr: 感知式人形运动策略通常输入稠密高程图，但真正影响控制的往往只是下一步足点周围地形，完整输入带来冗余并拖慢学习。作者先用品觉与速度指令训练轻量足点预测模型，再仅在预测足点附近采样高程图，为策略提供稀疏且具前瞻性的感知。该预处理把达到目标地形难度的训练迭代降到约三分之一，在稀疏足点、狭窄走廊和未见地形上优于完整地图策略，并可零样本迁移到 Unitree G1 跨越障碍、台阶与沟槽。
papers.abstract_en: Perceptive locomotion policies typically observe a dense robot-centric elevation map, although only the terrain beneath and around the next footsteps informs the control decision. Learned encoders compress the whole visual input, leaving the policy to work out which inputs matter while learning the baseline locomotion task. Learning both at once slows training and, without computationally expensive attention mechanisms, makes generalization to new terrain harder. We instead remove redundant inputs from the elevation map before the policy sees it. A lightweight foothold prediction model (FPM) predicts future footholds from proprioception and the velocity command alone, and we sample the elevation map only in small patches around these predicted footholds. We train the prediction model alongside the locomotion policy, periodically retraining it on new policy rollouts as the robot's gait matures. This allows the perception to anticipate where the policy will step, while the policy learns to leverage terrain information around those steps. With the proposed lightweight preprocessing, the policy reaches a given terrain difficulty in roughly a third of the training iterations required with the complete map. It outperforms policies that observe the complete map where footholds are sparse, including in narrow walled corridors, and on unseen terrain, and it matches an attention-based encoder trained at several times the cost. The policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 humanoid traversing various obstacles, stairs, gaps, and step-downs beyond the training distribution in both indoor and outdoor environments.

papers.title_en: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhaohui Yang, Quanbao Lin, Chengqi Shi, Zhenglang Weng, Jicheng Lin, Boyu Chen, Tengjie Zhu, Guanzhu Ren, Jiahao Xu, Yang Feng, Xiaokang Yang, Yao Mu
papers.evidence: 稀疏姿态驱动的人形机器人移动操作运动生成与全身控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人移动操作需在高层次任务意图与全身控制间建立高效接口，现有方法常以单一动作表示兼顾二者，易造成意图或协调欠定义。SP-HLM 提出稀疏姿态驱动接口，用五个关键身体姿态与学习到的潜在运动先验互补表达空间意图和全身协调；SP-VLA 预测稀疏姿态与手指关节，SP-MGM 实时重建全身运动，SP-GMT 融合显式目标与隐式先验完成控制。仿真与真机实验表明，该方法在运动跟踪、全身协调和移动操作成功率上优于现有方法，为高层策略与全身控制提供了可扩展接口。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. Given these sparse targets, SP-MGM, a motion generation model trained through two-stage distillation, reconstructs coordinated full-body motion in real time. A pretrained motion encoder maps this motion to a compact latent representation. SP-GMT, a general motion tracker, then integrates the explicit sparse targets with this implicit motion prior for whole-body control. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot demonstrate improved motion tracking, whole-body coordination, and loco-manipulation success over existing approaches. Additional results and videos are available on our \href{https://sp-hlm.github.io/}{\textcolor{blue}{project page}}.

papers.title_en: Data-Efficient Learning from Demonstration for Humanoid Robots via Feature-Level Perception and Prompt-Based Object Detection
papers.authors: Keyhan Rayati, AliReza Beigy, Anoosheh Saadati, Pourya Shahverdi, Mehdi Tale Masouleh, Ahmad Kalhor, Wing-Yue Geoffrey Louie
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人操作的数据高效示教学习
papers.tldr: 机器人通过人类演示学习技能时，视觉方法通常依赖大规模数据和昂贵的端到端训练。本文提出数据高效的LfD框架，用分层视觉预处理、Kinect人体关节估计、提示式目标检测与深度信息提取任务特征，再以时序模型预测关节轨迹。在NAO机器人上，仅用16次演示就在抓放任务上达到78%成功率，100次演示提升至86%，推动任务仅8次演示即达71%。
papers.abstract_en: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) allows robots to learn new skills from human examples; however, many vision-based methods require large datasets and resource-intensive end-to-end training. This paper introduces a data-efficient LfD framework for humanoid robots that learns manipulation skills from compact, task-specific features instead of raw images. The proposed approach integrates layered visual preprocessing, Kinect-based human joint estimation, prompt-based object detection, and depth information to extract human motion features and three-dimensional object locations from demonstration videos. These features are used to train a temporal deep learning model that predicts robot joint-angle trajectories for execution. The framework is implemented on a NAO humanoid robot, evaluated quantitatively in simulation, and demonstrated on physical hardware. In simulation, the robot achieves a 78% success rate on a pick-and-place task using only 16 demonstrations, which increases to 86% when trained with 100 demonstrations. The framework also achieves a 71% success rate on a pushing task using eight demonstrations, highlighting its effectiveness for data-efficient humanoid skill acquisition.

papers.title_en: Quantum algorithms for optimal control: large-scale finite-horizon linear-quadratic regulation
papers.authors: Xiajie Huang, Cristina Álvarez Yuste, Nikita Guseynov, Nana Liu, Javier González-Conde
papers.evidence: 面向有限时域LQR最优控制的量子算法
papers.tldr: 针对有限时域连续时间LQR，传统求解非线性Riccati方程在大规模长时控制中代价高。本文将状态-协态最优性方程改写为多重打靶线性系统，并把初末条件并入单一系统，借助量子线性求解器处理。作者在可稳定与可检测假设下证明条件数不随时域增长，并在稀疏块编码等条件下使查询与门复杂度对系统规模和时域呈多对数增长。该工作无需构造Riccati解算子即可给出最优代价与控制输入估计，为大规模最优控制提供量子加速路径。
papers.abstract_en: We develop quantum algorithms for optimal control over a prescribed finite time interval (finite horizon), focusing on continuous-time linear-quadratic regulation (LQR). This foundational control problem often requires solving a nonlinear matrix Riccati equation, which can be costly for large systems and long control durations on conventional classical solvers. We instead work directly with the state-costate optimality equations, reformulating the LQR problem as a multiple-shooting linear system. Importantly, we prove a condition-number bound for the system that is independent of the horizon, under stabilizability and detectability assumptions. By incorporating the initial and final conditions into a single linear system, we can solve the subsequent linear system more efficiently with a quantum linear systems subroutine. For a given initial state, our quantum algorithms return classical estimates of the optimal cost and the optimal control inputs at a selected time, without constructing a Riccati solution operator. Given sparse-matrix block-encodings, an initial-state preparation oracle and a fixed number of control inputs, the query and gate complexities scale polylogarithmically with system size and control duration, provided that sparsity, relevant norms, and stability parameters are bounded. The dependence on the target error is inverse-linear up to logarithmic factors. We establish the required bounds uniformly in system size and duration for a family of damped mass-spring chains with two endpoint controls. Numerical experiments support the analysis.

papers.title_en: From POMDP Theory to Deep RL with Particle Filters
papers.authors: Kevin Tan, Ziping Xu
papers.evidence: 结合粒子滤波与深度RL的POMDP不确定性规划
papers.tldr: 部分可观测环境中，基于模型强化学习的理论分析与深度RL实践存在脱节。该文提出端到端算法，用序列蒙特卡洛近似隐藏状态滤波，在线更新潜动力学模型，并以状态价值评论家自举进行d步在线规划。作者分析各近似并证明端到端遗憾界，将误差分解为模型估计、粒子滤波、蒙特卡洛rollout和QMDP结构偏差，显式揭示样本量、粒子预算、rollout预算与规划深度的影响。在MPC式深度RL框架中验证实用性，满足假设的POMDP上各误差项按预测速率衰减，为弥合理论与在线决策实践提供理论支撑路径。
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning in partially observable environments requires inferring hidden states, learning latent dynamics, and planning under the resulting belief. Practical algorithms often solve one aspect of the above pipeline while relying on approximations for the others that are often poorly understood, while existing POMDP theory typically analyzes computationally inefficient theoretical algorithms far from modern deep RL practice. To fill this gap, we propose a practical end-to-end algorithm that approximately solves the hidden state filtering problem via sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), updates a latent dynamics model online, and performs approximate online planning for $d$ steps before bootstrapping leaves with a state-value critic (a QMDP approximation). We analyze each approximation and prove an end-to-end regret bound decomposing the error into model estimation error, particle filter error, Monte Carlo rollout error, and a structural bias term induced by the QMDP approximation controllable by the planning depth that we further analyze in various special cases. The resulting guarantee makes explicit how statistical sample size, particle budget, rollout budget, and planning depth affect performance. We instantiate our algorithm in an MPC-based deep RL framework, demonstrating its practicality on a variety of environments. On a POMDP that satisfies our assumptions, each term of the bound decays at its predicted rate. Our results provide a practical and theoretically grounded route for bridging theory and practice within online decision-making in POMDPs.

papers.title_en: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
papers.authors: Liqian Ma, Vaibhav Saxena, Utkarsh Aashu Mishra, Shuo Cheng, Yongxin Chen, Danfei Xu
papers.evidence: 优化仿真器数据生成分布以促进机器人策略学习
papers.tldr: 仿真与真实协同训练可缓解真实数据稀缺，但现有方法把模拟器当作固定数据源，依赖均匀采样、离线检索或专家手工参数对齐。作者提出Active Generative Simulation问题，并给出MetaGenSim：用元梯度训练辅助评分网络，在用户指定的仿真参数空间内自动搜索高价值数据生成分布。在仿真与真实操作任务上，其真实世界全任务成功率较均匀生成提升150%，并追平专家手工对齐。这为自动化仿真数据配比提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website: https://meta-gensim.github.io

papers.title_en: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
papers.authors: Huixuan Cheng, Bike Zhang, Shankar Sastry, Koushil Sreenath
papers.evidence: 用扩散模型在权重空间生成建模人形机器人策略
papers.tldr: 人形机器人控制网络通常只通过训练获得，其权重分布能否被直接生成建模仍待探索。作者将线性自编码器与Diffusion Transformer结合，在压缩后的权重隐空间中做潜在扩散，并从Unitree G1的强化学习策略网络训练生成模型。生成网络可在真实世界完成行走、舞蹈和回旋踢，说明权重空间生成可行；进一步分析还发现首层权重稳定反映机器人运动学先验，且在强化学习与模仿学习下均出现。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/

papers.title_en: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
papers.authors: Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Junsong Wu, Weiji Xie, Qingyao Xu, Sheng Yin, Shiqing Wang, Jiyuan Shi, Siheng Chen, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 利用自我视角演示生成人形机器人全身VLA训练数据
papers.tldr: 训练人形全身VLA策略依赖昂贵的机器人演示，而人类第一视角数据虽易获取却存在视角错位与动作稀疏问题。KODA用可复用的规范轨迹引导机器人视角合成，并生成控制器相关的全身状态-动作监督。在Unitree G1四项任务、两种控制器下，人类演示覆盖但机器人数据缺失的条件成功率提升约45个百分点。该工作让第一视角人类视频可直接转为可复用、可跨控制器迁移的全身VLA训练数据。
papers.abstract_en: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

papers.title_en: CoEvolve: Self-Evolving Code Policies from Skills to Strategies for Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Zicheng Liu, Haochen Wu, Jiawei He, Suyun Zhao, Huan Yang, Cheng Chi, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人团队的自演化协调代码策略
papers.tldr: 单机器人受本体限制，多机协作需在物理执行偏离时自适应协调。CoEvolve将团队协作表示为基于固定运动技能的可执行代码，并引入验证器引导的协调进化：由多模态基础模型生成策略，物理验证每个执行转移，失败则从检查点结构化修正并保留经验。在两个Unitree G1搬运刚性载荷穿越受限走廊的仿真中，15次基础任务完成8次，三类骨干均取得端到端成功。结果表明可执行协调可作为长程多机协作的实用接口。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.

papers.title_en: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
papers.authors: Kanishk Bakshi, Amitansu Pattanaik, Kathiravan Srinivasan
papers.evidence: 带结构扩展与通道分配的新型网络架构
papers.tldr: 针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘与固定容量架构冲突，KFN用新颖性门控的结构扩展替代共享参数协商：新任务先在轻量专家网络中学习，再经结构融合模块分配专用通道容量并做双结构隔离。十任务Split CIFAR-100上任务10准确率71.16%，遗忘率较Replay低15.5个百分点，CIFAR-100与EuroSAT保留率显著领先。方法实现参数高效线性扩展并降低峰值显存，为超越固定容量架构提供实用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior representations. We introduce the Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN), which mitigates the stability-plasticity trade-off in class-incremental learning through novelty-gated structural expansion rather than parameter negotiation within a shared capacity budget. KFN decouples task acquisition from knowledge consolidation: each incoming task is learned in an isolated lightweight specialist network (2.8M parameters) and integrated into the global model via a Structural Fusion Module that allocates dedicated channel capacity conditioned on a quantitative novelty score. Dual structural isolation--channel-space separation with temporally phased gradient unfreezing--protects consolidated knowledge. On ten-task Split CIFAR-100, KFN achieves 11.94% minimum task accuracy and 71.16% task-10 accuracy, whereas shared-parameter baselines degrade severely: LwF to 9.07% average accuracy (0.00% min), Replay++ to 8.91% (85.08% forgetting), and Replay to 16.21% (73.44% forgetting); KFN's forgetting (57.92%) is 15.5 pp lower than Replay. Furthermore, KFN prevents logit-scale drift, maintaining near-symmetric task performance. Across CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT satellite imagery, KFN's class-incremental retention (72.7% and 42.5%) substantially exceeds the best baselines (29.6% and 0.94%). Crucially, KFN achieves parameter-efficient linear scaling, adding 25% of the base parameter count per step and requiring 25.1% of naive backbone duplication over ten tasks (28.1M vs 112.0M). With a 37.1% peak GPU memory reduction over full retraining, KFN establishes novelty-gated expansion as a practical path beyond fixed-capacity architectures.

papers.title_en: VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation
papers.authors: Shashwat Saxena, Mehul Goel, Sreyas Venkataraman, Sarvesh Patil, Max Simchowitz
papers.evidence: 训练策略以最大化各子目标critic值的线性组合
papers.tldr: 长程任务对强化学习仍具挑战，常见做法是分解子目标并训练子目标条件策略。VaDar 改为训练一个不依赖子目标的策略，通过线性组合各子目标评论家价值来隐式利用子目标信息。实验表明其常优于目标条件基线，并能处理非顺序目标与多目标优化。它还在 RoboCasa 上首次解决高难长程任务，说明子目标信息主要提升评论家学习而非策略条件化。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence.   We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the efficacy of critic learning, whereas policy goal-conditioning is often unnecessary.

papers.title_en: From Outcomes to Steps: Reliable Success-Aware Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.authors: Jiaxi Liu, Shixiong Kai, Zhentao Tang, Yang Li, Yuqi Cui, Mingxuan Yuan, Junchi Yan
papers.evidence: 面向长时程智能体的成功感知演员评论家
papers.tldr: 长程语言智能体仅获轨迹级监督时，传统评论家难以分辨中间动作对最终成功的局部影响，信用分配不可靠。SCALE在回报估计外显式预测各前缀的最终成功概率，并用Success-GAE将成功值变化转为多步动作信用，按预测可靠性调节权重，保留token级PPO目标。在五个基准和三个骨干上，SCALE多数设置优于RL基线，成功率最高提升4.1个百分点，并改善评论家估计与训练稳定性。它把结果监督细化为步骤级成功信号，提升长程智能体信用学习的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon language agents requires identifying whether intermediate actions make eventual task success more or less likely when supervision is available only at trajectory level. The main difficulty is that a critic with aggregate return-prediction accuracy may still fail to resolve the local value differences needed to assign credit to actions, especially under sparse feedback and function approximation. Conventional critics estimate future return, but policy improvement also depends on knowing whether each intermediate decision makes task success more or less likely. We introduce SCALE, an actor-critic framework that augments conventional return estimation with explicit prediction of eventual task success. At each interaction prefix, the critic predicts a return value and a Success Value, defined as the probability that the task will eventually be completed from that prefix. SCALE converts changes in Success Value into multi-step action credit through Success-GAE and modulates its contribution according to the estimated reliability of the predictor, while retaining the token-level PPO objective. Across five agent benchmarks and three model backbones, SCALE improves task performance over the compared RL baselines in most settings, with gains of up to 4.1 percentage points in success rate. Separate critic-learning analyses show that SCALE also improves critic estimation and training stability.

papers.title_en: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
papers.authors: Michael Chen, Hong Chul Nam, Xi Deng, Anima Anandkumar
papers.evidence: 不确定性下规划的噪声感知价值场
papers.tldr: 不确定执行噪声下的规划需要可靠反馈策略。PUN 用神经算子学习噪声感知价值场，并将障碍边界改为反射 Neumann、目标处 Dirichlet，扩展 Walk on Stars 到高维以生成无网格 PDE 解。训练从部分收敛的蒙特卡洛标签学习几何到场映射，推理用全局场引导的有界局部搜索。四维重规划基准在四种噪声下达 95–100% 成功率且运行最快，高噪声下成功率相对提升 10.7–60.6%。
papers.abstract_en: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.

papers.title_en: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
papers.authors: Chaorui Yao, Yuming Paul Zhang, Lin Yang, Yuhua Zhu
papers.evidence: 带价值评论家的无模型策略迭代
papers.tldr: 连续时间强化学习常面临只有固定离散off-policy批次、采样间隔缩小会使离散Q学习动作值差异消失的难题。本文提出无模型PhiBE策略迭代框架，每轮用单一状态-动作critic从采样增量学习并复用同一批数据改进策略，无需显式估计漂移或扩散。在线性函数近似下，作者建立局部端到端次优性保证，量化时间离散化、函数近似与有限样本策略评估误差的传播。研究还揭示采样间隔的偏差-方差权衡，表明更细离散化虽改善连续时间近似，却未必提升策略性能。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study continuous-time reinforcement learning, where the state follows an unknown stochastic differential equation but only a fixed off-policy batch of discrete-time transitions is available. Standard discrete-time Q-learning becomes problematic as the sampling interval shrinks, because differences between action values vanish. Continuous-time alternatives, such as Deep Advantage Updating and martingale q-learning, preserve the action signal but jointly learn a value function and an action-dependent critic. Building on the PhiBE-Q formulation (arXiv:2606.21925), we develop a model-free PhiBE policy iteration (PhiBE-PI) framework that uses a single state-action critic while preserving the continuous-time action-ranking scale. At each iteration, the framework learns the critic directly from sampled increments and uses it to improve the policy. The same batch is reused throughout, without explicitly estimating the drift or diffusion. We further develop an implementation under linear function approximation and establish a local end-to-end suboptimality guarantee for the learned policy. Our analysis quantifies how errors from time discretization, function approximation, and finite-sample policy evaluation propagate through policy iteration. It accounts for the dependence of successive policies on the reused data, so the guarantee does not require a fresh batch at each iteration. Moreover, we identify a bias-variance trade-off: smaller sampling intervals improve the approximation to the continuous-time problem but can increase statistical error at a fixed sample size. Thus, finer time discretization does not necessarily lead to better policy performance.

papers.title_en: Doob-Based Generative Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Maojiang Su, Qijie Zhu, Yu Xiao, Shuyang Yu, Minshuo Chen, Zhaoran Wang, Han Liu
papers.evidence: 生成式策略的免似然强化学习策略优化
papers.tldr: 扩散与流策略表达力强，但其动作似然不可解，难以直接套用PPO、GRPO等策略优化方法。DoobPO利用Doob h-transform将策略改进与生成策略学习解耦，先学习轻量比率模型，再通过条件漂移匹配把比率倾斜目标策略蒸馏进生成策略。理论证明该目标与理想Doob漂移匹配梯度等价，并对应端点约束随机最优控制的最小能量修正。MuJoCo连续控制实验显示其优于竞争性扩散与流策略基线，为生成策略的无似然RL微调提供原则性实用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. We prove that the practical conditional drift matching objective is gradient-equivalent to the ideal Doob drift matching objective. We further show that the induced diffusion process solves an endpoint-constrained stochastic optimal control problem. This establishes that it achieves the minimum-energy modification required to realize the desired policy tilt. Across MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, DoobPO achieves strong performance against competitive diffusion- and flow-policy baselines, showing a principled and practical route to RL fine-tuning for generative policies.

papers.title_en: Dynamical low-rank approximations for the optimal control of matrix ODEs
papers.authors: Benjamin Carrel, Tommaso Vanzan
papers.evidence: 利用低秩近似的动力学系统最优控制
papers.tldr: 针对矩阵状态动力系统开环最优控制中梯度法计算与存储开销大的问题，本文构建动态低秩近似（DLRA）框架，提出先优化后投影（OtP）与先投影后优化（PtO）两种范式。OtP对最优性系统整体降秩，PtO则先降秩状态方程再推导条件，使伴随变量位于状态切空间并满足协变ODE。作者给出梯度误差估计，揭示精度受初始终端低秩性、法向分量、稳定性与流形曲率影响，并设计对状态小奇异值稳健的时间离散，最后在随机抛物PDE控制上验证。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the open-loop optimal control of a dynamical system whose state is described by a time-dependent matrix $X(t)\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$. Gradient-based optimization methods may incur substantial computational and memory costs, particularly for large-scale systems and fine temporal discretizations. To alleviate this computational burden, we develop a mathematical framework to use Dynamical Low Rank Approximations (DLRA) in optimal control problems. We study two distinct paradigms: the first one, called Optimize-then-Project (OtP), first derives the optimality system and then approximates both the state and adjoint equations using DLRA. The second one, called Project-then-Optimize (PtO), first replaces the state equation with its DLR approximation, and then derives the optimality conditions for the resulting optimization problem. The two approaches differ fundamentally concerning the role of the adjoint variable. In OtP, the adjoint variable evolves on the manifold of fixed rank matrices, whereas in PtO, the adjoint variable belongs to the tangent space to the fixed-rank manifold at the evolving state variable. This latter formulation leads to a covariant ODE describing the dynamics of the adjoint variable as the underlying tangent space evolves in time. For both approaches we establish rigorous error estimates for the approximated gradients, identifying how their accuracy depends on the low-rank approximations of initial and terminal conditions, the components of the state and adjoint vector fields normal to the relevant tangent spaces, the stability properties of the dynamics, and the manifold curvature. PtO further requires tailored time discretization strategies for the adjoint covariant ODE, which we show to be robust against small singular values of the state variable. To illustrate the framework, we apply these methods to the optimal control of a random parabolic PDE.
